security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution matches are false positives caused by Markdown formatting. However, the skill relies on parent-directory references, an unpinned remote fallback, and persistent memory writes, which create review-boundary and persistence risks.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle the runbook, CITE reference, skill contract excerpts, and connector guidance inside the skill folder. Replace ../../../ links with packaged local references.

remediation.issue: Mutable remote fallback for required instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove the raw GitHub main-branch fallback. If remote retrieval remains necessary, pin a commit hash and require explicit user confirmation before loading it.
Require explicit user approval before writing audit results to memory files, and sanitize untrusted domain evidence before adding it to hot-cache context.

content.user_title: Audit Domain Authority and Citation Trust
content.value_statement: Domain trust signals are hard to compare when backlink, entity, and citation data are scattered. This skill applies CITE scoring, veto checks, and prioritized fixes for clear domain authority decisions.
actual_capabilities: Scores domains across 40 CITE criteria in Citation, Identity, Trust, and Eminence.
Applies domain-type weight tables to calculate a CITE score.
Checks veto triggers for link-traffic mismatch, manipulation networks, and penalty history.
Produces dimension scores, priority improvements, and a practical action plan.
Supports manual data entry when SEO, link, and AI citation tools are unavailable.
Creates a handoff summary for related SEO and authority workflows.
limitations: It depends on user-provided or connected backlink, traffic, and citation data.
It does not replace a page-level content quality audit.
It cannot verify private Search Console or SEO platform data without access.
Some referenced runbook material may need to be bundled for standalone use.

use_cases.title: Pre-Campaign Authority Check
use_cases.description: Audit a domain before a GEO or SEO campaign to find trust blockers and high-impact improvements.

use_cases.title: Citation Source Review
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether a domain is credible enough to use as a source in AI or editorial workflows.

use_cases.title: Competitive Trust Benchmark
use_cases.description: Compare your domain against competitors using consistent CITE dimensions and domain-type weights.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit domain authority for example.com. Use the CITE framework and tell me whether the domain is trusted, cautious, or untrusted.

prompt_templates.title: Audit by Domain Type
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the business model is known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a CITE domain audit for example.com as an e-commerce site. Show dimension scores, veto checks, and the top five fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitors
prompt_templates.scenario: Benchmark several domains with the same criteria.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare domain authority for example.com, competitor-one.com, and competitor-two.com. Highlight trust gaps and recommended next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Full Authority Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit example.com with CITE scoring, note missing data, apply veto rules, and recommend whether to run content, backlink, or entity optimization next.

output_examples.input: Audit example.com as a SaaS domain with manual backlink and traffic data.
output: Verdict: CAUTIOUS because link quality is acceptable, but identity signals are incomplete.
CITE score: 68 out of 100 after SaaS weightings.
Top fixes: complete organization schema, improve branded SERP coverage, and earn citations from trusted industry sources.

output_examples.input: Compare our domain with two competitors before a GEO campaign.
output: Your domain has stronger trust signals but weaker AI citation presence than both competitors.
The best next action is to strengthen entity profiles before expanding content production.
Missing AI citation data was marked as not available and excluded from affected averages.

output_examples.input: Check whether a prospective citation source is trustworthy.
output: Verdict: UNTRUSTED due to a manipulation signal in the backlink profile.
Use a different source until the domain resolves the trust issue.
The report lists the observed evidence and a safer replacement criteria checklist.

best_practices: Confirm the domain type before scoring because weights change by business model.
Provide backlink, traffic, AI citation, and entity data when available.
Review veto checks before interpreting the final score.
anti_patterns: Do not use the score as a full page-level content quality assessment.
Do not treat missing private platform data as a failed trust signal.
Do not compare domains with different data sources without noting the gap.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits domain authority and citation trust using the 40-item CITE framework.

faq.question: Does it require SEO tool access?
faq.answer: No. It can work with manual data, but connected tools improve evidence quality.

faq.question: Can it audit individual pages?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on domain-level authority, not detailed page-level content quality.

faq.question: What are veto checks?
faq.answer: Veto checks flag severe trust issues such as manipulation patterns or penalty history.

faq.question: How should I use the final score?
faq.answer: Use it as a directional trust benchmark and pair it with the listed evidence.

faq.question: Can it compare competitors?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare several domains when similar evidence is available for each one.
